rows.grounds: compound of sudhā (nectar), dhārā (stream), and samā (equal)
feminine noun vāṇī in nominative singular
pra-jan in middle voice present tense

items.question: What speech-related sign appears from the mouth of the long-lived practitioner?
items.inference: The practitioner's mouth produces nectar-like speech.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasmin remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Speech like a stream of nectar arises from his mouth.
